title.zh: 根据产品与项目资料，提供全天候客户问答
title.en: Round-the-clock answers from product and project records

profile.zh: 某粉体工程装备企业，产品线复杂、技术参数多
profile.en: An engineering equipment company with complex product lines and technical specifications.

label.zh: 产品资料与历史项目检索

before.zh: 客户问题要等工程师回复，销售现场查资料慢
before.en: Customers waited for engineers. Sales teams searched through scattered documentation.

after.zh: AI 基于真实产品资料与项目记录即时回答，并为每位客户生成专属材料
after.en: Answers based on product records, equipment matching and customer-specific sales material.

outcome.zh: 上线后，该企业的线上咨询实现 7×24 小时专业应答，销售在客户现场即可秒级调取产品资料、相似项目与报价参考。
outcome.en: The engineering team now supports round-the-clock professional inquiries. Salespeople can retrieve specifications, comparable projects and pricing references in the field.

background.zh: 客户是一家粉体工程装备企业，产品覆盖粉碎、分级和成套产线，型号与技术参数繁多。客户的问题常常涉及物料特性、产能和工况，过去需要工程师结合以往项目才能回答。
background.en: The client builds powder-processing equipment — milling, classifying and complete production lines — with a large catalogue of models and specifications. Customer questions usually involve material properties, throughput and operating conditions, and used to require an engineer who knew past projects.

challenges.zh: 选型问题依赖少数资深工程师，回复慢
challenges.en: Sizing questions depended on a few senior engineers, so replies were slow

challenges.zh: 产品手册、参数表和项目记录分散在不同系统
challenges.en: Manuals, spec sheets and project records lived in separate systems

challenges.zh: 销售材料没有结合客户的行业和工况
challenges.en: Sales material ignored the customer's industry and conditions

approach.zh: 整理产品手册、参数表和历史项目，建立按型号与物料检索的知识库
approach.en: Organised manuals, spec sheets and past projects into a knowledge base searchable by model and material

approach.zh: 对外咨询入口按问题引导对话，回答附带资料来源
approach.en: A customer-facing assistant guides each conversation and cites its sources

approach.zh: 内部工作台为销售匹配相似项目和报价参考
approach.en: An internal workbench matches sales with comparable projects and pricing references

approach.zh: 按客户行业与工况生成一客一稿的方案材料
approach.en: Generates proposal material tailored to each customer's industry and conditions

title.zh: 把方案初稿从两天缩短到 15 分钟
title.en: From two days to 15 minutes: AI-drafted proposals and reports

profile.zh: 某专业咨询与投研机构，方案与报告撰写量大、论证要求高
profile.en: A professional consulting and research firm producing high volumes of evidence-based proposals.

before.zh: 2 天撰写并反复核对资料
before.en: Two days of drafting, followed by repeated manual checks.

after.zh: 15 分钟生成初稿并执行完整性检查，再由人工修改、复核
after.en: A draft in 15 minutes, automatically checked for completeness and ready for human review.

outcome.zh: 上线后，该机构的撰写团队把主要精力从整理资料转向打磨核心论证，方案初稿 15 分钟内即可生成。
outcome.en: Writers spend less time assembling source material and more time improving the argument. A first draft can be generated in 15 minutes.

background.zh: 客户是一家专业咨询与投研机构，每月要完成大量方案和研究报告。每份报告都要整理甲方诉求、行业资料和财务测算，过去一份初稿通常需要两天。
background.en: The client is a consulting and investment-research firm that produces a steady stream of proposals and research reports. Each one combines client requirements, industry research and financial analysis, and a first draft used to take about two days.

challenges.zh: 历史报告和调研资料分散，难以复用
challenges.en: Past reports and research were scattered and hard to reuse

challenges.zh: 论证框架依赖个人经验，质量不稳定
challenges.en: Argument structure depended on individual experience, so quality varied

challenges.zh: 提交前缺少系统化的完整性检查
challenges.en: There was no systematic completeness check before submission

approach.zh: 按甲方沟通、调研、论证、输出梳理项目工作流
approach.en: Mapped the workflow into client briefing, research, analysis and output stages

approach.zh: AI 助手整理沟通记录，提取核心诉求并写入报告草稿
approach.en: An AI assistant structures meeting notes, extracts key requirements and writes them into the draft

approach.zh: 从七个维度自动检查报告完整性，并标出关键假设的风险
approach.en: Checks every draft against seven completeness criteria and flags risky assumptions

approach.zh: 初稿可编辑、可追溯，由分析师复核后定稿
approach.en: Drafts stay editable and traceable; analysts review and sign off

model.zh: 低启动试点 + 持续服务

duration.zh: 试点 4 周，全面上线 8 周

title.zh: AI 处理 80% 常见咨询，平均响应低于 3 秒
title.en: AI handles 80% of routine inquiries, averaging under 3 seconds

system.zh: Enterprise Wiki 智能 IT 助手

profile.zh: 某大型企业 IT 部门，内部员工规模大、工单量高
profile.en: An enterprise IT department supporting a large internal workforce and a high volume of requests.

before.zh: 员工排队等 IT 回复，同一问题反复解答
before.en: Employees queued for IT support, with the same questions answered repeatedly.

after.zh: 3 秒内获得带出处的答案，复杂问题自动转人工
after.en: Cited answers in seconds, with complex requests routed to a human.

outcome.zh: 该项目中，AI 自动处理了 80% 的常见咨询，减少 IT 团队重复回答问题的时间。
outcome.en: AI now handles 80% of routine inquiries, giving the IT team more time for systems work that requires their expertise.

background.zh: 客户是一家大型企业的 IT 部门。员工规模大，日常咨询集中在账号、设备、网络和安全制度上，大量重复问题占用了支持团队的时间。
background.en: The client is the IT department of a large enterprise. Most day-to-day questions are about accounts, devices, networks and security policy, and repeat questions were eating up the support team's time.

challenges.zh: 重复咨询多，工单持续积压
challenges.en: Repeat questions kept the ticket queue full

challenges.zh: 制度更新后，旧答案仍在流传
challenges.en: Outdated answers kept circulating after policy updates

challenges.zh: 不同岗位能查看的资料范围不同
challenges.en: Different roles were allowed to see different documents

approach.zh: 接入内部 Wiki、制度文档和工单系统，按权限建立索引
approach.en: Connected the internal wiki, policy documents and ticketing system, indexed with access controls

approach.zh: 回答附带制度出处，员工可直接查看原文
approach.en: Every answer cites the policy it came from, with a link to the original

approach.zh: 无法确认的问题自动生成工单摘要，转给 IT 工程师
approach.en: Questions it cannot confirm become ticket summaries routed to IT engineers

approach.zh: 看板跟踪拦截率、响应时间和热门问题，持续补充知识库
approach.en: A dashboard tracks deflection rate, response time and top questions to keep the knowledge base current

model.zh: 低启动试点 + 持续服务

title.zh: 业务人员直接提问，查询库存与销量
title.en: Query inventory and sales in plain language

profile.zh: 某零售与供应链企业，SKU 多、库存与销量数据量大
profile.en: A retail and supply chain business with a large SKU catalog and extensive inventory and sales data.

before.zh: 提需求给 IT，等待一天甚至更久
before.en: Business users filed a request and waited a day or longer for a data export.

after.zh: 业务人员直接提问，秒级拿到表格与图表
after.en: A plain-language question returns a table or chart within seconds.

outcome.zh: 上线后，该企业的业务人员可以用自然语言直接查询库存与销量数据，常规查数不再依赖 IT 部门。
outcome.en: Business teams query inventory and sales directly. Routine reporting no longer depends on the IT queue.

background.zh: 客户是一家零售与供应链企业，SKU 多、销售区域多，业务团队每天都要查看库存和销量。过去所有临时查询都要提交给 IT 导数。
background.en: The client is a retail and supply-chain business with many SKUs and regions. Business teams check stock and sales every day, and every ad-hoc question used to go to IT as a data-export request.

challenges.zh: 临时查询要排队，常常等一天以上
challenges.en: Ad-hoc questions waited in a queue, often for more than a day

challenges.zh: 同一指标在不同报表中口径不一
challenges.en: The same metric was defined differently across reports

challenges.zh: 业务人员不会写 SQL，只能看固定报表
challenges.en: Business users could not write SQL and were limited to fixed reports

approach.zh: 梳理常用指标口径，建立统一的数据字典
approach.en: Defined common metrics once in a shared data dictionary

approach.zh: 用自然语言提问，系统生成查询并展示可核对的 SQL
approach.en: Users ask in plain language; the system writes the query and shows SQL that can be checked

approach.zh: 按角色控制可查询的数据范围
approach.en: Role-based access controls what each user can query

approach.zh: 结果以表格和图表返回，可导出到报表
approach.en: Results come back as tables and charts, ready to export

title.zh: 从沟通记录提取费用，按房产整理收支
title.en: Extract expenses from messages and organize property accounts

system.zh: AlphaHouse 房东记账与管理工具

profile.zh: 某房产管理与租赁运营方，管理多套出租物业
profile.en: A property management and rental operator overseeing multiple rental properties.

before.zh: 沟通记录、费用往来散落在不同渠道，账目靠手工整理
before.en: Messages and expenses were scattered across channels and reconciled by hand.

after.zh: AI 自动提取租赁、维修与管理费用，生成账单与物业表现报告
after.en: AI extracts rental, repair and management expenses into property-level statements.

outcome.zh: 上线后，该运营方的房产账目由 AI 从日常沟通中自动归集，屋主可以随时查看每套房产的收支与投资表现。
outcome.en: Daily communication becomes structured accounts. Owners can review income, expenses and investment performance for each property.

background.zh: 客户管理多套出租物业，与租客、维修工和物业的沟通都在手机上完成。租金、维修费和管理费散落在聊天记录里，月底对账全靠手工整理。
background.en: The client manages a portfolio of rental properties and handles tenants, repair technicians and building offices from a phone. Rent, repair costs and management fees were buried in chat threads, and month-end reconciliation was done by hand.

challenges.zh: 费用信息散落在聊天和转账记录中
challenges.en: Cost details were scattered across chats and payment records

challenges.zh: 手工对账耗时，容易遗漏
challenges.en: Manual reconciliation was slow and error-prone

challenges.zh: 屋主难以看清每套房产的真实收益
challenges.en: Owners could not see the true return of each property

approach.zh: 在手机端统一管理与租客、维修工和物业的沟通
approach.en: One mobile app for conversations with tenants, technicians and building offices

approach.zh: AI 从消息中识别租金、维修和管理费用
approach.en: AI picks out rent, repair and management costs from messages

approach.zh: 自动生成每套房产的账单明细
approach.en: Itemised statements are generated for every property

approach.zh: 按月汇总收支与出租情况，形成投资表现报告
approach.en: Monthly income, costs and occupancy roll up into a performance report

title.zh: 管理百万字长篇的人物设定与剧情分支
title.en: Manage character details and branches in million-word stories

profile.zh: 某内容创作团队，长期创作长篇小说与剧本
profile.en: A content production team creating long-form fiction and scripts.

label.zh: 兼容主流模型并支持私有模型部署

before.zh: 长篇创作中 AI 混淆人物设定与剧情分支
before.en: Long-form AI writing confused character facts and alternate storylines.

after.zh: 可控记忆层按需调用设定与上下文，分支之间互不干扰
after.en: A controlled memory layer loads the right context and keeps branches separate.

outcome.zh: 上线后，该团队在长篇创作中可以精确管理人物设定与剧情分支，AI 输出与既有设定保持一致。
outcome.en: Writers manage character settings and story branches, with relevant records retrieved for each generation.

background.zh: 客户是一个长期创作长篇小说与剧本的内容团队。一部作品动辄几十万到上百万字，人物设定、世界观和剧情分支数量庞大。
background.en: The client is a content studio that writes long-form fiction and scripts. A single work can run from hundreds of thousands to over a million words, with large numbers of characters, world details and plot branches.

challenges.zh: 长对话中，AI 会混淆人物设定
challenges.en: In long sessions, AI mixed up character details

challenges.zh: 多条剧情分支互相干扰
challenges.en: Plot branches bled into each other

challenges.zh: 通用工具无法控制哪些内容进入上下文
challenges.en: General-purpose tools gave no control over what entered the context

approach.zh: 建立可控记忆层，按人物、世界观和剧情节点分类管理设定
approach.en: A controllable memory layer organises characters, world settings and plot points

approach.zh: 当前对话只载入需要的设定片段，并显示上下文占用
approach.en: Each session loads only the details it needs and shows context usage

approach.zh: 剧情分支独立存档，切换时互不影响
approach.en: Plot branches are saved separately and never contaminate each other

approach.zh: 兼容主流模型，也可接入专门训练的私有写作模型
approach.en: Works with mainstream models or a privately trained writing model
